verdict.rationale: Pricing transparency about seat minimums and annual commitments is a fair question for a SaaS work-management product, so the axis applies. The pack only says the Free plan needs no credit card and has unlimited time. Nothing documents seat minimums, seat-count tiers, or monthly-versus-annual billing commitments on paid plans.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know whether my plan enforces a minimum seat count or annual billing commitment before I subscribe
